key.name: corner
key.description: Corner of the screen where the PiP window will be placed: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left

key.name: offset
key.description: Distance from the chosen corner in pixels

key.name: always-on-top
key.description: Keep PiP windows above all other windows

key.name: always-on-all-workspaces
key.description: Show PiP windows on every workspace

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Radius of the PiP window's rounded corners in pixels, 0 disables rounding

key.name: never-in-focus
key.description: Move keyboard focus back to another window when a PiP window takes it; moving or resizing the PiP window still works

key.name: do-not-show-on-overview
key.description: Hide PiP windows from the Overview workspace previews and thumbnails
